findings.highlight: There wasn’t any postponement since that day
findings.evidenceJa: 猶予なんて、あの日からなかった
findings.governingReading: There has been no leeway or time to spare since that day.
findings.explanation: The English uses the wrong concept and produces unnatural wording.

findings.highlight: I have to decide everything right now
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の事。これからの事を、俺はここで決めなければ
findings.governingReading: Shirou must decide here what to do about Sakura and their future.
findings.explanation: The English broadens two specified matters into everything.

findings.governingReading: The hidden speaker confirms that this is Emiya Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English removes the confirming force of the identification.

findings.highlight: I heard it from within this room
findings.evidenceJa: それもすぐ近く、この部屋から声がした
findings.governingReading: The voice comes from immediately nearby, inside the room.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the room but omits terrifying proximity.

findings.evidenceJa: 髑髏の面をしたサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: The voice belongs to the Servant wearing a skull mask.
findings.explanation: The English omits the mask and invents whiteness.

findings.highlight: His specialty may be killing people
findings.governingReading: Assassin’s profession is covert action and infiltration.
findings.explanation: The English replaces stealth with killing people, obscuring why bypassing the barrier is remarkable.

findings.highlight: It’ll take two full steps, three full seconds to dash out to the hallway into the yard
findings.evidenceJa: 全力で畳を蹴って二歩、廊下から中庭まで転がり出るのに三秒
findings.governingReading: Shirou calculates two full-force steps kicking off the tatami, then three seconds to roll from the hallway into the courtyard.
findings.explanation: The English removes the kick and roll and muddles the direction of travel.

findings.highlight: That’s not to say it isn’t actually a trap
findings.evidenceJa: その内容がどんな物で、それ自体が罠かどうかは別の話
findings.governingReading: The content of Zouken’s proposal and whether the meeting itself is a trap remain separate unresolved questions.
findings.explanation: The English retains trap uncertainty but omits the unknown content and the explicit distinction.
